mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('cg:', c.caregiver_id) AS user_id, c.care_nm AS name, COALESCE(w.ward_nm, '미배정') AS ward, 'APPROVED' AS status FROM tb_caregiver c LEFT JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = c.location_id LEFT JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE c.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalDomain} AND c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY c.crt_dt DESC, c.caregiver_id DESC

SELECT CONCAT('cg:', c.caregiver_id) AS user_id, c.care_nm AS user_name, 'APPROVED' AS auth_status, l.ward_id, w.ward_nm AS ward_name, c.phone_no AS phone_number, NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(l.location_nm, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS room_number, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS assigned_rooms FROM tb_caregiver c LEFT JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = c.location_id LEFT JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE c.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalDomain} AND c.use_yn = 'Y'
AND LOWER(c.care_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%')
ORDER BY c.care_nm, c.caregiver_id

SELECT CONCAT('cg:', c.caregiver_id) AS user_id, c.care_nm AS user_name, 'INACTIVE' AS auth_status, l.ward_id, w.ward_nm AS ward_name, c.upd_dt AS deactivated_at, NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(l.location_nm, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '') AS room_number FROM tb_caregiver c LEFT JOIN tb_location l ON l.location_id = c.location_id LEFT JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE c.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalDomain} AND c.use_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.upd_dt DESC, c.caregiver_id
SELECT caregiver_id, location_id, phone_no AS phone_number, use_yn FROM tb_caregiver WHERE hosp_div_id = #{hospitalDomain} AND caregiver_id = #{caregiverId}

SELECT l.location_id FROM tb_location l JOIN tb_ward w ON w.ward_id = l.ward_id WHERE w.hosp_div_id = #{hospitalDomain} AND REPLACE(w.ward_nm, ' ', '') = CONCAT(#{wardNumber}, '병동') AND l.location_type = 'ROOM' AND l.location_nm = #{locationName} ORDER BY l.location_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_caregiver (care_nm, hosp_div_id, location_id, phone_no, use_yn, crt_dt, upd_dt) VALUES (#{caregiverName}, #{hospitalDomain}, #{locationId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{phoneNumber}, 'Y', NOW(), NOW())
